messages:
tara: Quick follow-up: we should converge on a single minimal handshake so Private can run without sidecar by default. Idea: tiny capability probe + auth hint, then cache per-tenant. Low-risk, opt-in flag first.

omar: Short questionwhat's the probe latency budget? We can't add >2ms on p90.

tara: Plan is async probe on first route + cache. Probe should be <10ms on warm connections; cold may be higher. We only block on the first request for a tenant during rollout.

li: Security note: do not send unwrapped keys to controlplane. Use attestation token from runtime and mTLS.

tara: Yep. runtime returns an attestation reference, controlplane validates signature, never sees raw key.

omar: How do we handle old Private installs? They won't have the endpoint.

tara: Compat adapter: controlplane falls back to the sidecar protocol if probe times out or manifest missing. Mark tenant as "legacy_compat" in cache and surface a warning in console + metric.

li: Add audit log when compat mapping created (tenant, reason, deploy id). Security wants retention policy.

tara: Will add audit event and tie to retention config.

release-bot: reminder: add feature-flag private_handshake_v2 to releases board.

omar: We need metrics: discovery_latency_ms, discovery_fail_rate, compat_fallback_rate. Also circuit breaker: if discovery_fail_rate > 5% over 5m, auto-fall back most tenants to compat until ops investigation.

tara: Agreed. Also suggest allowing runtime to emit cap_ttl_seconds (min 60, max 3600) so we honor short lived changes but avoid thundering probes.

li: Add webhook for manifest-change events so tenants can invalidate cache immediately on key rotation.

omar: Testing: unit parse tests, small emulated runtime integration, and a Dedicated canary before enabling for Private.

tara: Rollout checklist (brief):
- enable feature flag for internal tenants
- run Dedicated canary (48h)
- enable for Private staging customer
- watch discovery_* metrics and compat_fallback_rate

li: small API sketch (literal payloads):
```
# POST /_rwd/discover
{"probe_version":"v1","client_build":"2026-03-20","probe":"probe"}

# runtime response (200)
{"tenant_id":"acme","capabilities":["kvcache","batching"],"auth_chain":"attestation+mTLS","preferred_model_variants":["q4_0","q8_0"],"cap_ttl_seconds":300}
```

omar: Keep max_seq_len advisory only. Also include preferred_model_variants so routing can pick cheaper variants in Dedicated.

tara: Noted. Also, compat adapter cost likely higher; we'll expose compat_routed_requests in billing dashboard so sales/finance can track.

security: Do not forget to require TLS client certs and verify runtime identity against tenant manifest. Also capture attestation token TTL.

li: I'll draft the minimal runtime README and example probe server for on-prem teams.

omar: I'll pair with Li on the integration tests. Tara will draft the follow-up RFC with handshake state machine + circuit breaker rules?

tara: Yup, I'll own the RFC and add the tiny state diagram. Thanks all. :+1:
